Support
our mission.

Prep Up is sustained by community-led generosity. Whether you're a private donor, a local business, or a grantmaking foundation, your support fuels equitable college access for Southcoast students.

Every contribution funds free college counseling for a Southcoast student.

Serving the
Southcoast.

Prep Up serves students from New Bedford, Fall River, and the surrounding Southcoast communities — adapting the high-touch college counseling model of independent schools for a community-based program at no cost to families.

Your contribution underwrites the cohort programming, individual counseling sessions, campus visits, application support, and financial-aid guidance that make up the four-year Prep Up curriculum.

Your financial support of Prep Up helps open doors for Southcoast students.
